title: Australian Shiitake Mushroom Bowl
description:
A hearty and flavorful bowl filled with sautéed shiitake mushrooms, 
   served with a side of fresh citrus and a sprinkle of yellow turmeric.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the shiitake mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the mushroom broth, soy sauce, black pepper, and salt to the skillet.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the mushrooms are tender.
Stir in the yellow turmeric and cook for an additional minute.
Serve the mushrooms over a bed of rice or noodles, garnished with fresh citrus.
